summary.text: Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick said the American AI Exports Program is intended to deploy American AI systems globally and promote full-stack U.S. solutions for economic and national security. He also said Commerce would act to keep advanced U.S. technology from adversaries and that certain AI chips would not be sold to China, subject to detailed license terms. Lutnick described CAISI as evaluating commercial AI systems under national-security standards and cited Commerce and NIST work on AI standards and evaluations. He has also promoted AI data centers and energy infrastructure and a US-UAE AI partnership.
